notes: Base VIA Campus² model (not the VIA Campus² PLUS variant, which adds an HDMI input). Specs taken from Kramer's official combined VIA Campus²/VIA Campus² PLUS user manual (Technical Specifications, p.137), cross-checked against Markertek's and conferencetableboxes.com's spec tables which mirror Kramer's own datasheet wording. Power is supplied via an external 120W (19V, 6.32A) power adapter/brick connecting to the unit via a DC barrel-style jack; the unit also has a separate physical "Power Toggle" on a 2-pin terminal block (an on/off switch, not modeled as a separate port). No grade set on HDMI/DisplayPort outputs even though max resolutions are documented (4K@30 RGB for HDMI out, 4K@60 for DisplayPort out) because the manual does not state an HDMI/DP version number (e.g., 2.0 vs 1.4) — stating a grade without a confirmed spec version would risk misclassification. Desktop unit; no standard rack mounting confirmed for this generation (an optional rack adapter existed for the original, non-"2" VIA Campus, not confirmed for Campus²), so rackUnits is omitted. Wi-Fi antenna connectors (2x, on threaded RF connectors) are omitted from ports as they are proprietary antenna connectors, not in the accepted connector list.
